pages.title: Biosphere Compendium
pages.text: Beef, pork, chicken, mutton, rabbit and cod, every edible animal pressed into one dense block. It smells of a farmyard, a kitchen and a fishing dock all at once. It is technically food, and absolutely not for eating.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Building the catalyst meant compressing every field of knowledge, including biology. On the Extreme Assembly Table I pressed one of each edible creature together into a single record of the food chain.
Made in $(item)Extreme Assembly Table$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Stellar Engineering.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Omniscience Catalyst.
